title: Chaihu-Shugan-San ameliorates chronic atrophic gastritis by inhibiting nuclear factor-kappa B-mediated inflammation and apoptosis.
authors: Song, Jin; Li, Dan-Yan; Zhang, Xiao-Li; He, Sha-Sha; Wang, Ning; Zhang, Hui-Cun; Bai, Yun-Jing; Li, Bo; Zhang, Sheng-Sheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方柴胡疏肝散通过NF-κB通路改善慢性萎缩性胃炎，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chaihu-Shugan-San (CSS), a classic traditional Chinese medicine formula, has demonstrated significant efficacy in treating various gastrointestinal disorders. AIM: To explore the therapeutic efficacy of CSS in alleviating chronic atrophic gastritis (CAG), and elucidate the underlying mechanisms of action. METHODS: High performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry was used to identify the main active components of CSS. The therapeutic effects of CSS at doses of 925 mg/kg/day and 1850 mg/kg/day on N-methyl-N'-nitro-N-nitrosoguanidine (MNNG)-induced CAG were evaluated. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict the potential targets of CSS in CAG. The impact of CSS on the gut microbiota of rats was investigated by 16S rRNA sequencing. RESULTS: The main active components of CSS were lipids and lipid-like molecules, phenylpropanoids and polyketides. In vivo experiments showed that CSS significantly ameliorated MNNG-induced CAG by inhibiting inflammation and apoptosis. The core target of CSS to alleviate CAG were tumor necrosis factor, interleukin (IL)-1beta, IL-6, BAX, BCL2, caspase-3/caspase-9, and NFKBIA. Gene Ontology analysis of these core targets revealed their predominant association with the nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) signaling complex and BAX apoptotic complex. Molecular docking demonstrated that six compounds in CSS, including baicalin, licoisoflavone B, licochalcone B, glabrone, glycyrrhiza flavonol A, and marmin exhibited strong binding affinities with NFKBIA. 16S rRNA sequencing indicated that CSS promoted beneficial changes in the colonic microbial community. CONCLUSION: CSS alleviated CAG by inhibiting NF-kappaB-mediated inflammation and apoptosis, providing insights into its mechanism of action in protection against CAG.
abstract_zh: 背景：柴胡疏肝散（CSS）作为一种经典中药方剂，在治疗多种胃肠疾病中显示出显著疗效。目的：探讨CSS在缓解慢性萎缩性胃炎（CAG）中的治疗功效，并阐明其潜在作用机制。方法：采用高效液相色谱-质谱联用技术鉴定CSS的主要活性成分。评估了CSS在剂量为925 mg/kg/天和1850 mg/kg/天时对N-甲基-N'-硝基-N-亚硝基胍（MNNG）诱导的CAG的治疗效果。通过网络药理学和分子对接预测CSS在CAG中的潜在靶点。通过16S rRNA测序研究CSS对大鼠肠道微生物群的影响。结果：CSS的主要活性成分为脂质及脂质样分子、苯丙素类和聚酮类化合物。体内实验表明，CSS通过抑制炎症和凋亡显著改善MNNG诱导的CAG。CSS缓解CAG的核心靶点为肿瘤坏死因子、白细胞介素（IL）-1β、IL-6、BAX、BCL2、caspase-3/caspase-9及NFKBIA。这些核心靶点的基因本体论分析显示，它们主要与核因子-κB（NF-κB）信号复合物和BAX凋亡复合物相关。分子对接表明，CSS中的六种化合物，包括黄芩苷、甘草异黄酮B、甘草查尔酮B、光甘草酮、甘草黄酮醇A和 marmin，与NFKBIA表现出强结合亲和力。16S rRNA测序表明，CSS促进了结肠微生物群落的有利变化。结论：CSS通过抑制NF-κB介导的炎症和凋亡缓解CAG，为其在保护CAG中的作用机制提供了见解。
